data.gist: BMAX was at least as effective as BMAC in this rat PTOA model and better on some outcomes; authors speculate retained native stromal matrix may overcome BMAC's known limitations.
data.plain: The authors summarize that the micronized, matrix-rich bone marrow matched BMAC in reducing osteoarthritis signs and exceeded it on some measures. They note documented shortcomings of BMAC in clinical studies (symptom relief without true hyaline cartilage restoration, possibly due to its very low stem cell content) and propose — as a possible mechanism, not a demonstrated one — that preserving the native marrow matrix environment improves stem cell function.
